title: Spirited Journeys
description: Set off on a journey with friends in this RPG modpack. Explore various structures and lands, as countless monsters and loot await you. then return home with tales of your adventures and maybe even settle down and enjoy what the simple life has to offer.
body:
Welcome to Spirited Journeys! An Adventure RPG modpack where you set off and explore a world filled with structures and lands. venture forth in the spirit of the nameless and experience the world of magical and adorable encounters. traverse through difficult terrains and fight beings of surprising strength. then come home and take a moment's respite before setting of on another conquest.

Starting your journey~ find a place to call home and build a sanctuary of safety in a world of dangers and strife. Arm yourself with weapons and armors of various kinds and defend your home from uninvited intruders.

Venture forth! explore the world and its many mysteries, plunge the depths of ruined chambers for loot, swim in the ocean and witness its pretty aquaculture, and go beyond the stars and witness its magnificence.

Enjoy a life of peace and prosperity. A journey has to come to an end before a new one begins. You can experience a moment of respite rich in various pursuits of artisanship. The culinary world is as rich as the adventuring world.
